name: Footer
description: Application footer. In its simple version, only the bottom bar with the copyright and social links. In its full version, also the brand with its tagline and a row of FooterColumn, with a divider between the two parts.

dos: Use `variant="simple"` (default) on product or tool pages. Use `variant="full"` on the home page or on content pages that need secondary navigation.
Put at most three or four FooterColumn in the columns row, each with its title and links.
Put the copyright in the bottom bar and leave the social links on the right, as in Figma.
Use `showSocial={false}` if the application has no social networks. The bottom bar keeps only the copyright.

donts.case: Main application navigation inside the footer
donts.why: The footer is secondary navigation. Main destinations must always be in view, at the top.

donts.case: A subscription or contact form inside the footer
donts.useInstead: Form in its own page section
donts.why: The footer has no space or states for a form. The Form needs a header, errors and confirmation.

donts.case: More than one footer per page
donts.useInstead: A single footer at the end of the document
donts.why: A second footer confuses screen readers: the page footer must be unique (contentinfo landmark).

donts.case: A footer with long text or several paragraphs
donts.useInstead: A content page linked from the footer
donts.why: The columns and the bar have a fixed size in Figma. Long text breaks the row and reads poorly on mobile.

related.difference: Each column in the links row is a FooterColumn (only in variant=full).
The social links are ghost IconButton of size 2 (see needsReview: destination of each one).
Horizontal divider between the brand and the bottom bar (only in variant=full).
Navbar is the main navigation at the top; Footer is the secondary navigation and the page bottom.
The brand logo is a 20 px circle-check Icon, not an image (see needsReview).

props.name: variant
props.description: Footer version. simple = only the bottom bar (copyright and social links). full = also the brand with its tagline, the FooterColumn row and the divider. In Figma, the component set default is simple.

props.name: showSocial
props.description: If true, shows the group of social links (three IconButton) in the bottom bar. If false, the bar carries only the copyright.

root.description: Root element. Column with the top part (full only), the divider (full only) and the bottom bar. Has a neutral.2 background and a top stroke.
root.figmaLayer: Footer (each variant of the component set)

top.description: Top part: brand and columns row. Only with variant=full.

brand.description: Brand block: logo, name and tagline. Column with 12 px gap.

brandRow.description: Logo and name row. 8 px gap.

logo.description: Brand logo: 20 px circle-check Icon, fixed in Figma.

name.description: Brand name "Mokkapp", fixed text in Figma. Not a property.

tagline.description: Tagline "Sistemas de diseño basados en contratos.", fixed text in Figma. Not a property.

columns.description: FooterColumn row. On desktop, horizontal with 40 px between columns; on mobile, vertical. Only with variant=full.

divider.description: 1 px horizontal divider, color neutral-alpha.6. Only with variant=full.

bottom.description: Bottom bar: copyright on the left and social links on the right on desktop; stacked on mobile.

legal.description: Copyright "© 2026 Mokkapp Studio", fixed text in Figma. Not a property.

social.description: Group of social links. Only with showSocial=true. Three ghost IconButton of size 2 in Figma (LinkedIn, GitHub, YouTube).

height.note: Height of the simple version on desktop (129 px = 48 + 32 for the bar + 48 padding). The full version depends on the height of the columns.

modes.fixed: 1280 px on desktop and 375 px on mobile, in the Figma example.

width.note: In Figma, the component is 1280 px wide on desktop and 375 px on mobile; its actual width is set by the viewport.

autoLayout.gap: spacing.6 (32 px) between the top part, the divider and the bottom bar (desktop and mobile).

desktop.gap: spacing.8 (48 px) between the brand and the columns

mobile.gap: spacing.6 (32 px) between the brand and the columns
24 px (derived from the column heights in Figma; no variable)

a11y.role: contentinfo (implicit on footer outside article and section)
a11y.name: Needs no name if it is the only footer on the page.
keyboard: Tab — moves through the columns, links and social buttons in order
a11y.focusIndicator: Inherited by FooterColumn (Link), IconButton and Divider from their contracts. The footer adds no ring of its own.
a11y.minTarget: Social buttons are 32 × 32 px. FooterColumn links are 20 px tall: see FooterColumn's needsReview.
a11y.contrastNote: neutral.12 text (name) and neutral.11 (tagline and copyright) on neutral.2. Not measured in Figma.

label.voice: Fixed Figma texts: brand "Mokkapp", tagline "Sistemas de diseño basados en contratos.", copyright "© 2026 Mokkapp Studio". The column titles and links belong to FooterColumn.

behavior.overflow: wrap: the copyright, tagline and links wrap on mobile. Figma does not define this case.

responsive.desktop: Padding 48 px top and bottom, 32 px on the sides. Brand and columns horizontal; bottom bar with copyright and social links apart.
responsive.mobile: Padding 32 px top and bottom, 16 px on the sides. Brand and columns stacked; bottom bar stacked, with 16 px between copyright and social links.

i18n.rtl: The bottom bar is mirrored: the copyright moves to the right and the social links to the left. The column order follows.
i18n.textExpansion: The copyright and tagline wrap. On desktop, a row of wider columns can overflow the 1216 px one: check with long texts.

cases: renders a footer with the bottom bar always visible
variant=simple hides top and divider; variant=full shows them
showSocial=false hides the social group; the bar keeps the copyright
the divider is a 1 px horizontal Divider with neutral-alpha.6
on desktop, padding 48 px vertical and 32 px horizontal; on mobile, 32 px and 16 px
columns are 40 px apart on desktop and stacked on mobile
the columns slot accepts FooterColumn and rejects Link and Button
the footer has a neutral.2 background and a neutral-alpha.6 top stroke

needsReview: The component set has 4 variants: breakpoint (desktop, mobile) × variant (simple, full). All read. simple hides top and divider; full shows them. The breakpoint changes the padding and the direction of the top part, the columns and the bottom bar.

breakpoint property: not a prop. It is documented in behavior.responsive, as in Navbar, because in code it is a media query. The cutoff between desktop (1280 px) and mobile (375 px) is not defined in Figma.
variant property (simple, full): exposed as a prop. Default simple, which is the component set default.
showSocial property (BOOLEAN, default true): controls the social layer of the bottom bar. Exposed as the showSocial prop. Note: in FooterColumn, showSocial had no layers; here it does.
Fixed texts with no property: brand "Mokkapp", tagline, copyright "© 2026 Mokkapp Studio". Question: add text properties in Figma or approve them in code? No props have been added.
Column titles and links: three FooterColumn instances with their fixed titles and links (instance overrides). Figma does not allow changing them from the Footer.
Logo: 20 px circle-check Icon, not an image. Decide whether the brand should carry a real logo (image or its own SVG) instead of an example icon.

Social links: three ghost IconButton of size 2 (LinkedIn, GitHub, YouTube), with an icon per instance swap. Problem: IconButton is a button and has no href, but these elements must lead to a URL. Decide whether they are Link with an icon (and change the contract) or IconButton with onPress and the destination in the application. Also, IconButton requires aria-label and Figma does not define the texts (e.g. "LinkedIn").

Mobile gap: the columns stack with 24 px between them, a value derived from the component heights in Figma (344 px total height with three columns of 108, 108 and 80 px). No variable: confirm and, if wanted, create a token.
Gap between brand and columns: 48 px on desktop (spacing.8) and 32 px on mobile (spacing.6), bound to a variable.
Footer top stroke: neutral-alpha.6 with 0.15 opacity on the stroke itself, as in Navbar and Form. The opacity has no token and the stroke position is documented as top by convention; verify by hand.
Divider: 1 px horizontal Divider with neutral-alpha.6 and 0.15 opacity on the fill itself (same case as the stroke).
Height: the simple version on desktop is 129 px. The full version was not computed as a fixed value because it depends on the height of the columns.
Measurements with no variable: 20 px logo (Icon accepts '20'), 24 px mobile gap (see above), 1280 / 375 px example width (viewport), and 1216 px of content (1280 minus 64 of horizontal padding).

Content, guidance, a11y (implicit contentinfo), testing and content: written as a draft. They do not come from Figma. Own decisions: single footer landmark, showSocial=false as a use case and the recommendation not to include main navigation or forms.
Contrast not measured. Figma defines no focus or hover states for the footer links.
governance: null, same as Button. Component owners still need to be defined.
